description.en-US: Miscellanies, volume I (1877): essays and addresses of 1863-72: Roma Aeterna, the work and wants of the Catholic Church in England, Father Faber, Cardinal Wiseman, Garibaldi's visit, French infidelity, Ireland, on progress, and the Daemon of Socrates.
description.pt-BR: Miscelânea, volume I (1877): ensaios e discursos de 1863-72: Roma Aeterna, a obra e as necessidades da Igreja Católica na Inglaterra, o Padre Faber, o Cardeal Wiseman, a visita de Garibaldi, a incredulidade francesa, a Irlanda, sobre o progresso e o demônio de Sócrates.

en-US.editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Oates, 1877)

sources.edition: Miscellanies (vol. 1) (London: Burns and Oates, 1877), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The essays, lectures and addresses in order; the contents, the publisher's list and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1877, so the text is public domain.
